title: 你身体里的一秒钟 / One Second Inside You

acts.title: 一秒钟 / One Second
acts.description: A calibrated stopwatch measures a literal one-second interval.

acts.title: 把时间放慢 / Time Dilation
acts.description: A 120× replay reveals the standing anatomical figure and initializes live telemetry.

acts.title: 信号与心跳 / Signals and Systole
acts.description: Nerve impulses reach the brain. The ventricles contract and eject blood.

acts.title: 氧气接力 / Oxygen Relay
acts.description: Red cells pass through a capillary. Oxygen crosses into muscle and reaches a mitochondrion.

acts.title: 分子涡轮 / Molecular Turbine
acts.description: Protons drive ATP synthase. One rotor turn supports three catalytic ATP events.

acts.title: 瞬时开门 / Voltage-Gated Channel
acts.description: The ECG R-wave and sodium channel opening share one onset. The gate opens for one biological millisecond.

acts.title: 回到全身 / Return to the Body
acts.description: A reverse pullback from the membrane through the organelle, cell, capillary and heart returns to the standing body.

acts.title: 这一秒的清单 / The One-Second Tally
acts.description: The clock freezes at 1.000 s with all eight completed estimates visible together.

acts.title: 你身体里的一秒钟 / One Second Inside You
acts.description: The last heartbeat settles into a bilingual reflection and the final title.
